Spiky, medium-length jet black hair with a messy, unkempt texture. Narrow, intense crimson red eyes with a stern expression. Apparent age of twenty-five with a hardened maturity. Broad-shouldered and muscular build. A deep navy blue sleeveless kimono with a heavy black obi belt. A single scarred line crossing the bridge of the nose.
BODY COLOR: golden tan skin
